藏品名称_EN: celadon box with inlaid boys and flower design
藏品名称_ZN: 瓷盒，镶嵌有男孩和花朵图案
描述_EN: as well as vases, bottles, cups and jugs, small circular boxes like this one were made in considerable numbers, often bearing repetitive decorations incorporating plant, animal and figural designs. the sloping, ridged edge of the cover echoes a type of ceramic box made in song dynasty china, and which was certainly known in korea. in korea during the koryo dynasty, 918-1392, inlaid decoration was introduced on green glazed ceramics. here, two naked babies make part of the scrolling pattern that surrounds the centre of the lid.
描述_ZN: 除了花瓶、瓶子、杯子和水壶，像这样的小圆盒也被大量制造，通常带有重复的装饰，包括植物、动物和人物图案。 盖子的倾斜棱角与宋代中国制造的一种陶盒相呼应，这种陶盒在韩国当然也有。 在韩国的高丽王朝（918-1392年），绿色釉面陶瓷上出现了镶嵌式装饰。 这里，两个裸体的婴儿构成了环绕盖子中心的滚动图案的一部分。
